description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'StoreLogoUrlTag' used to generate the URL for a store's logo image within a web application. It constructs the image URL based on store configuration and store details, and outputs it in the JSP page.

classes.name: StoreLogoUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag that generates the URL for a store's logo image, used within JSP pages to dynamically display the store logo based on store configuration and context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Builds and outputs the URL for the store's logo image, either default or custom, when the JSP tag is invoked.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the custom tag processing, allowing the rest of the JSP page to continue rendering.
